name: Camping Wohnmobilstellplatz Plankenhof
beschreibung: Camping Wohnmobilstellplatz Plankenhof is located in Pill, a scenic municipality in the Tyrolean Unterland. Managed by a working farm, the site provides straightforward pitches for motorhomes and tents. Set in a quiet hillside location, it boasts lovely views over the Inn Valley. Modern sanitary facilities and electrical hookups are readily available. Hiking trails start directly from the grounds or in the immediate surroundings. Plankenhof is perfectly suited as a convenient stopover for travellers or for tranquil days immersed in nature.
